غللتما (form I)
# غَلَلْتُمَا (ḡalaltumā) /ɣa.lal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# غُلِلْتُمَا (ḡuliltumā) /ɣu.lil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
